title: Machine-assisted Writing Evaluation: Exploring Pre-trained Language Models in Analyzing Argumentative Moves
reasoning: The study evaluates the reliability of a BERT-based model in classifying argumentative moves within student writing. While the research utilizes a theoretical framework grounded in developmental epistemology (mapping moves to stages like Absolutism or Evaluativism) and uses a moral argument (cloning) as a pedagogical example, the primary component of the paper is natural language processing and writing evaluation metrics, not the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or epistemological systems themselves.
